findings.text: the three committed SVGs are 3420501, 3321629 and 1768864 bytes (332456 added lines, ~8.5 MB), each 6-11x the 300 KB data-file threshold; the plan mandates them under docs/figures/ so it is not a scope breach, but an imas-ink decimation option is the fix and the worker recorded the same under follow_ons.

read_channel's docstring states a half-written channel is refused, but the guard at lines 298-301 catches only open failures, so a channel whose time array exists at a different length is returned rather than refused, and no test exercises the refusal path.

_flux_loop_indices walks the raw Zarr group (store[category].array_keys(), the _time suffix) to enumerate cached flux loops instead of the eddb.py layout owners, so the cache layout is known in two places; no public enumerator exists to extend, so this is a note rather than a duplicate owner.

item_verdicts.call_sites: the only production callers of read_channel are scripts/figures_jt60sa_signals.py:_bound_panel and _flux_panel; the test file is not a production call site.
item_verdicts.diff: read the single commit 2aecdec7 against base 7e975e9c; eddb.py gains read_channel, the test gains one round-trip test, and the script, three SVGs and the fragment are added.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names tests/data/test_eddb_cache.py and the ruff command; the manifest records 31 passed and ruff exit 0, and logs/figures.log records the per-figure channel names/units and time-base differences the done-when requires.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to render the JT-60SA cached-pulse signal figures through imas-ink from a new eddb.read_channel; scripts/figures_jt60sa_signals.py:_main renders three figures through imas_ink time_trace_figure_mpl and imas_ambix/data/eddb.py:280 adds read_channel.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states tests/data/test_eddb_cache.py 31 passed and names head_eddb_cache.log, ruff.log, figures.log and negative_control.log.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares six write paths; the seven paths in the diff all sit inside them.

justifications.durability: tests/data/test_eddb_cache.py:323 test_read_channel_round_trips_data_time_base_and_unit fails on the declared mutation (logs/negative_control.log reddens the time-base assertion), so it guards read_channel, but the figures script has no test covering its output.
justifications.evidence: the done-when's pytest and ruff runs are recorded in the reviewed manifest and logs (31 passed, exit 0) and logs/figures.log carries the printed channel names/units and time-base differences.
justifications.fit: imas_ambix/data/eddb.py:280 read_channel sits beside write_channel and reuses channel_path/channel_time_path/UNIT_ATTR/EddbCacheError, but scripts/figures_jt60sa_signals.py:45 redeclares _UNITS_ATTR = "units" instead of importing the module's UNIT_ATTR.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_ambix/data/eddb.py:280 adds read_channel and scripts/figures_jt60sa_signals.py renders the three cached-pulse figures through imas-ink exactly as the goal states.
justifications.reuse: no added definition duplicates an existing capability (eddb.py owns no channel enumerator), but scripts/figures_jt60sa_signals.py:112 re-derives the Zarr layout its channel_path/time_array_name own.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff is inside the manifest's declared write paths, but the commit adds 332456 lines of generated SVG (~8.5 MB) exceeding the 300 KB data-file landing threshold even though the plan mandates the figures under docs/figures/.
